notes.title: Version 0.2.0
notes.notes:
I made a few Quality of Life changes and added more buttons to the game.

That includes:
[list]
[*]Added a button to toggle the shivering. No more shaking if you don't like it!
[*]Added a button that links to the hamster item store page.
[*]Made window resizing possible. ([i]Note:  The game always tries to keep it's aspect ratio so you might have black bars after resizing.[/i])
[/list]

notes.title: Discord Rich Presence fix
notes.notes: There was a chance the discord rich presence could break the game initialization. That should be fixed now. Please update your game :)
